bio.short: Mubashir Rehman is a backend software engineer in Lahore, Pakistan (3+ years, full-time) who builds the systems behind messy, multi-system workflows and adds AI where it helps.
bio.medium: Mubashir Rehman is a backend software engineer in Lahore, Pakistan, with 3+ years of full-time experience. He is a Lead Software Engineer at TransData, where he has led a team of five since March 2026. He builds the systems behind messy business workflows and then owns them after launch. Right now that is an AI voice front desk for dental clinics and its AWS backend. He co-authored a peer-reviewed Springer journal paper in 2025.
about: I build the systems behind messy, multi-system workflows, and then I keep them running. My habit is to find the problem, understand the system underneath it, build the fix, and stay for what breaks next.

At TransData, where I have led a team of five since March 2026, I took an AI voice front desk for dental clinics from AI-scaffolded code to a production launch, then designed and deployed its AWS backend on services verified as HIPAA-eligible. I have also built agents that work inside a live ERP, and a social-signal intelligence backend I wrote alone for a client.

Before that, at VeritusLabs, I was promoted to team lead about three months in and led four engineers on drone-control software. For five semesters I was a teaching assistant for operating systems at Information Technology University.
